after.alt: A rectangular map crossed by a river drawn as thick lines with three junctions. Segment P enters from the left edge and ends at the left junction; from there R runs up to the top edge and Q runs right to the middle junction. From the middle junction S runs down to the bottom edge and T runs right to the right junction, from which V runs up-right and U runs down-right to the right edge. Zones: Z2 top-left (above P, left of R); Z3 top-middle (right of R, above Q, T and V); Z4 at the right between V and U; Z5 bottom-middle (right of S, below T and U); Z1 bottom-left (below P and Q, left of S). So P separates Z1|Z2, R separates Z2|Z3, Q separates Z1|Z3, S separates Z1|Z5, T separates Z3|Z5, V separates Z3|Z4 and U separates Z4|Z5.
